topics.label: Introduction to cancer hallmarks and tumor progression
topics.groupedBecause: This opening subtopic introduces the lecture objectives, framework, and progression model of cancer hallmarks.

topics.label: Deregulation of growth signaling cascades
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how oncogenic mutations disrupt extracellular sensing and downstream pathways such as Wnt and receptor tyrosine kinases to drive continuous proliferation.

topics.label: Block in terminal differentiation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how cancer cells in hematopoietic lineages and the intestinal epithelium arrest terminal differentiation while retaining proliferative capacity.

topics.label: Evasion of apoptosis, senescence, and replicative limits
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe how cancer cells circumvent programmed cell death, telomere-driven senescence, and p53-mediated stress responses to achieve replicative immortality.

topics.label: Metabolic rewiring and oncometabolites in cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how tumor cells alter cellular metabolism through aerobic glycolysis, tissue-specific profiles, and metabolic enzyme mutations.

topics.label: Tumor angiogenesis and the angiogenic switch
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains the biological necessity, regulatory balance, and timing of blood vessel formation required to support tumor growth.

topics.label: Mechanisms, dynamics, and genomics of metastasis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics analyse the multi-step dissemination cascade, metastatic inefficiency, seed-and-soil interactions, and associated genomic features such as whole genome duplication.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and recommended reading
topics.groupedBecause: This closing subtopic reviews the overarching framework of cancer hallmarks and provides concluding administrative and reading recommendations.
